en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a landscaped spa park with a central marble statue group on a plinth, flanked by flowerbeds and paths. Two women in long dresses and wide hats stand on the path. Behind them are dense trees and a pavilion-like building. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the location as Bad Elster and mentions the Hygiea statue and promenade in the spa park.
